resources.string: Anonymous diagnostics (disabled in Raksha Mobile OS)
Telemetry and anonymous statistics reporting are disabled in Raksha Mobile OS.
External telemetry is disabled in Raksha Mobile OS
Security patches are released monthly for Android and SoC components. Keep Raksha Mobile OS and your host One UI firmware up to date for the latest protections.
OneOS runs Raksha Mobile OS in container permissive mode over your host One UI kernel so the guest can start cleanly. Your host One UI system remains SELinux Enforcing when you return.
